residency.test: Unlimited liability if you have a Wohnsitz (a home available to you) or habitual abode of more than six months in Germany.
residency.note: A registered address (Anmeldung) is strong evidence of a Wohnsitz. Unlike most countries, keeping a flat available can create residence even with few days of presence.
residency.worldwide_income: Yes for unlimited taxpayers; progression clause (Progressionsvorbehalt) raises the rate on German income even where foreign income is exempt by treaty.

headline.rates: continuous formula from 14% to 42%, then 45% above 277,825
headline.solidarity_surcharge: 5.5% of income tax, only above a high exemption threshold
headline.church_tax: 8% or 9% of income tax if registered with a church

income_tax.name: Einkommensteuer
income_tax.note: EStG section 32a formula - the rate rises continuously rather than in steps

standard_deduction.name: Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag
standard_deduction.note: flat employment expense allowance; claim actual costs instead if higher

employee.name: Krankenversicherung (health)
employee.note: 7.3% general plus half of the 2.5% average supplementary rate

surcharges.name: Solidaritätszuschlag
surcharges.note: charged on the whole income tax once assessed tax exceeds the exemption limit; a sliding transition band applies just above it

capital_gains.rate: 25% Abgeltungsteuer plus solidarity surcharge and any church tax
capital_gains.real_estate: gains exempt after a ten-year holding period, or if the property was your own home for the year of sale and the two preceding years
capital_gains.shares: the flat rate applies; substantial shareholdings of 1% or more fall under the partial income procedure

quirks: Tax classes (Steuerklassen I to VI) change monthly withholding, not the annual liability. A married couple in classes III/V will see very different payslips from IV/IV but the same final assessment.
Church tax is collected with income tax and only stops when you formally leave the church (Kirchenaustritt), which has a fee and takes effect from a specific date.
The Progressionsvorbehalt means tax-free foreign income and benefits such as Elterngeld or Kurzarbeitergeld still push up the rate on your German income.
Health insurance is capped, so between the health ceiling (66,150) and the pension ceiling (96,600) the effective marginal wedge actually falls before rising again.
Filing is mandatory in defined cases (multiple employers, tax class combinations, side income above 410) but voluntary filers often get a refund - the average refund is around 1,000.

reporting.authority: Finanzamt (local tax office), coordinated by the Bundeszentralamt für Steuern
reporting.who_must_file: Mandatory where you had tax class combinations III/V or IV with factor, more than one employer, wage replacement benefits over 410, side income over 410, or you are self-employed. Everyone else may file voluntarily within four years.

deadlines.what: Return for tax year 2025 if filing yourself
Return for 2025 if a Steuerberater or Lohnsteuerhilfeverein files for you
Last date for a voluntary return for 2025 (four-year window)

documents_to_collect: Receipts for work-related expenses above the 1,230 allowance - commuting, home office, professional training
Certificates for donations, childcare costs and household services (Handwerkerleistungen)

penalties.late_filing: Verspätungszuschlag of 0.25% of the assessed tax per month, minimum 25 per month
penalties.late_payment: Säumniszuschlag of 1% of the outstanding amount per month
penalties.interest: 0.15% per month from 15 months after the end of the tax year

warnings: Church tax (8-9% of income tax) is not included. Add it if the taxpayer is a registered church member.
The solidarity surcharge transition band just above the exemption limit is simplified.
Health insurance here is the statutory scheme. Privately insured taxpayers pay a fixed premium instead, which changes the result substantially.
